items.item_text: resume
cover letter
Data system development and implementation experience
This is a TEMPORARY position within our Temporary Office of the President Staffing (TOPS) program.
Provide dedicated analytical support to a team of busy labor relations professionals

Handle critical, confidential and attorney-client-privileged information directly related to union collective bargaining agreements, negotiations, union grievances, contract management, union requests for information under HEERA, represented employee data sets, and wage implementation related decisions and plans

Perform intake and workflow management for various labor relations processes including grievances, parameters requests, requests for information and other bargaining-related needs including contract management

Case management and tracking of information primarily related to grievance processing, parameter requests, requests for information and other bargaining-related activities for Systemwide Labor Relations
Develop expertise in UC data systems and applications related to the management of represented employee data including UCPath, Cognos and FTP/GoAnywhere
Handle large, complex and confidential data sets; perform data entry and analysis; update records; produce detailed reports using SmartSheet, Excel and other programs as needed
Manage flow of sensitive represented employee data between UCOP, UC locations and unions
Timely and highly accurate updating of critical UCNet webpages related to specific union contracts and the collective bargaining process
Communicate verbally and in writing in a professional manner across all levels of the organization and with external partners including other UC locations and union representatives
Electronic document management of confidential and attorney-client-privileged materials via NetDocs, UCOP share drive, Box, SharePoint, SmartSheet and other systems as needed
Provide back-up support for operational tasks in the following areas:
Business systems support including Concur/Connexxus, Box, SharePoint, SmartSheet, T:drive.
Signature routing via DocuSign as needed, ensuring that proper content and format guidelines are followed
Monitor and manage department email accounts, adhering to department protocols
Meeting and event support (in-person, online or hybrid) including scheduling, agendas, notes, and logistics
General office support as needed
Background in human resources and/or employee and labor relations
Familiar with labor law, employment policies and regulations
Knowledge of case management and business systems (e.g., SharePoint, SmartSheet, NetDocs)
